turns.question: What was the median gap in hours between consecutive orders of the same customer in September 2026, counting only customers with at least two orders?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: nothing computes the time between a customer's consecutive orders, or a median of it. The closest metrics are repeat_customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order in the period who have placed two or more orders in all), orders_total (all orders placed, cancelled included) and customers_distinct (active customers); the layer also has no median metric at all (median_order_value_eur is not available here).
